title: Mark Zuckerberg and Alexandr Wang don't seem to like Guinness very much
key_facts: Mark Zuckerberg and Alexandr Wang joined Stripe cofounder John Collison on the podcast 'Cheeky Pint', which is customarily recorded over pints of Guinness.
The episode ran 134 minutes and covered Meta's AI ambitions, its new personal AI agent Muse and its large spending plans.
Zuckerberg said he brought Collison a keg of Guinness from Dublin.
Viewers shared a clip of Zuckerberg sipping, swilling the stout and appearing to wince; commentator Ed Zitron joked he should 'spit it out'.
Tyler Cosgrove, who works on the TBPN podcast, counted roughly 1.4 pints for Zuckerberg, 1.2 for Collison and 0.8 for Wang, who nursed one glass without finishing it.
Zuckerberg said he uses Muse to analyse video of his MMA training; Wang described using his agent to source tea from vendors in Taiwan and Japan.
Meta did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
quote_evidence: Mark Zuckerberg and Alexandr Wang joined Stripe cofounder John Collison for a beer on the latest episode of "Cheeky Pint" — but viewers aren’t convinced the Meta executives were converted to Guinness.
Meta did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Zuckerberg and Wang's thoughts on the taste of Guinness.
why_it_matters_hint: A light viral moment around two Meta leaders; no consequence beyond online jokes.
event_date: Not stated; the episode is called the latest one and clips were circulating by 13 Oct 2026
